mono.subject: 056-curie
mono.title: 居里与物质深处
mono.titleEnglish: Curie and the Depths of Matter

phrase.zh: 认真测量，让未知元素显形。

visual.zh: 人物、矿石与精细实验器具围成一处安静工作台，表现从样品中追踪新物质的过程。矿石和仪器不是实验室档案照片。
visual.en: A stylized figure, minerals and delicate apparatus form a quiet bench, suggesting a search for new substances in samples. This is not an archival photograph of a laboratory.

background.zh: 玛丽·居里和皮埃尔·居里通过测量矿物的放射性，发现了钋和镭。她在 1903 年分享物理学诺贝尔奖，并在 1911 年因放射化学研究获化学奖；画里的光晕并非放射性的真实可见外观。
background.en: Marie and Pierre Curie measured radioactivity in minerals and discovered polonium and radium. She shared the 1903 Physics Nobel Prize and received the 1911 Chemistry Prize for her work; the painted glow is not how radioactivity visibly appears.
